name: Feature request

title: "[FEATURE] "

---

## Feature

Describe the feature you would like to see.

## Problem

What problem would this solve?

## Proposed Behavior

Explain how you think the feature should work.

## Why This Belongs in Phoenix Baileys V3

Phoenix Baileys V3 aims to stay close to upstream Baileys.

Please explain why this feature should be implemented as a Phoenix-specific change instead of application-level code.

## Upstream Status

If known:

- Does upstream Baileys already support this?
- Is there an upstream issue or pull request?
- Is this functionality missing upstream?

## Compatibility

Could this change affect:

- message generation
- authentication
- sessions
- groups
- LID / PN handling
- protocol behavior
- existing Phoenix patches

## Additional Context

Add examples, screenshots, protocol details, or other useful information.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues first
- [ ] I checked whether upstream Baileys already provides this functionality
- [ ] This feature has a concrete use case
